_comment: Model architecture profiles for TCNAttentionSEClassifier. Select with --model-profile. 'input_dim' is always set automatically at runtime from the feature count — do not add it here.

default._comment: Full-size model. Receptive field: (3-1) × (2^6 - 1) × 2 + 1 = 253 bars. Matches SEQ_LEN=128.

small._comment: Faster to train / debug. Receptive field: (3-1) × (2^4 - 1) × 2 + 1 = 61 bars.

large._comment: Deeper model for longer sequences (SEQ_LEN=256+). Receptive field ≈ 509 bars.
